questions.q_en: Two trains, P and Q start from stations A and B towards each other. P and Q take 5 hours 20 minutes and 8 hours 20 minutes to reach B and A respectively after they meet. If train P is moving at 55 km/hr, then find the speed of train Q.
questions.solution_en:
Time of P = 5 hours 20 minutes = 16/3 hours

Time of Q = 8 hour 20 minutes = 25/3 hours

Speed of P/Speed of Q = √(Time of Q/ Time of P)

55/ Speed of Q = √[(25/3)/(16/3)]

55/ Speed of Q = 5/4

Speed of Q = 55 * 4/ 5 = 44 km/hr

questions.q_en: A sum of Rs. 5000 amounts to Rs. 9400 in 4 years at (r + 8)% rate of simple interest. Find the interest obtained on Rs. 7500 at r% rate of simple interest after 2 years.
questions.solution_en:
Interest obtained = 9400 - 5000 = Rs. 4400

According to question,

4400 = [5000 * (r + 8) * 4]/100

=> r + 8 = (4400 * 100)/(5000 * 4)

=> r + 8 = 22

=> r = 14

Interest obtained on Rs. 7500 at r% rate of simple interest = (7500 * 14 * 2)/100 = Rs. 2100

questions.q_en: The area of a square shaped field is 1764 m2. The breadth of a rectangular park is 1/3rd of the side of the square field and its length is two times its breadth. What is the cost (in ₹) of levelling the park at ₹15 per m2?
questions.solution_en:
Area of square field = 1764

Side of square field = √1764 = 42 m

Breadth of rectangular park = 42 * 1/3 = 14 m

Length of rectangular park = 14 * 2 = 28 m

Area of rectangular park = 14 * 28 = 392 sq.m

Cost of levelling park at Rs.15 per sq. m = 15 * 392 = Rs.5880

questions.q_en: What is the cube root of the product of all positive multiples of 8 less than 45?
questions.solution_en:
a + 5 is an odd number, for even number, a + 5 is added or subtracted from 1, 3, 5 etc.

(a) a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even), a + 3 = a + 5 - 2 (odd)

(b) a = a + 5 - 5 (even), a - 1 = a + 5 - 6 (odd)

(c) a + 1 = a + 5 - 4 (odd), a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even)

(d) a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even), a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even)

Hence, option 'd' is correct.

questions.q_en: Diya and Riya are partners in a traveling business. Diya invests Rs. 2800 for 35 months and Riya invests Rs. 4200 for 14 months. Out of total profit of Rs. 3480, what will be the share of profit of Diya?
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of investment of Diya and Riya = (2800 * 35): (4200 * 14) = 5: 3

Hence, share of profit of Diya = 5/8 * 3480 = Rs. 2175

questions.q_en: A spherical iron ball with 4 m external radius has mass of 3564 kg. What is the thickness of the shell if the density of iron ball is 13.5 kg/m3?
questions.solution_en:
External radius r2 = 4 m

Mass = 3564 kg

Density = 13.5 kg/m3

Internal radius = r1

Volume = 4/3 π (r23 - r13)

= 4/3 X 22/7 (43 - r13)

Density = mass/volume

13.5 = 3564 X 21 / {88 X (43 - r13)}

(43 - r13) = 3564 X 21 / (88 X 13.5) = 63

r13 = 64 - 63 = 1

r1 = 1 m

Thickness of iron ball = 4 - 1 = 3 m

questions.q_en: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 25 days, B and C together can complete the same piece of work in 36 days, while C and A together can complete it in 30 days. If A, B, C, and D together can complete this piece of work in 18 days, then in how many days can D alone complete this piece of work?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 25, 36, 30 and 18 = 900 units

Efficiency of A + B = 900/25 = 36 ----(1)

Efficiency of B + C = 900/36 = 25 ----(2)

Efficiency of C + A = 900/30 = 30 ------(3)

Efficiency of A + B + C + D = 900/18 = 50 ------(4)

Eqn(4) - [eqn (1) + eqn(2) + eqn(3)]/2:

Efficiency of D = 50 - (36 + 25 + 30)/2 = 50 - 45.5 = 4.5

Time taken by D = 900/4.5 = 200 days
questions.solution_hi:
Total work = LCM of 25, 36, 30 and 18 = 900 units

Efficiency of A + B = 900/25 = 36 ----(1)

Efficiency of B + C = 900/36 = 25 ----(2)

Efficiency of C + A = 900/30 = 30 ------(3)

Efficiency of A + B + C + D = 900/18 = 50 ------(4)

Eqn(4) - [eqn (1) + eqn(2) + eqn(3)]/2:

Efficiency of D = 50 - (36 + 25 + 30)/2 = 50 - 45.5 = 4.5

Time taken by D = 900/4.5 = 200 days

questions.q_en: The least number which when divided by 18, 12, 16 and 24 leaves remainder 6 in each case is:
questions.solution_en:
Least number which when divided by 18, 12, 16 and 24 leaves remainder 6 in each case = LCM of 18, 12, 16 and 24 + Common remainder

LCM of 18, 12, 16 and 24 = 144

Common remainder = 6

Required number = 144 + 6

= 150

questions.q_en: The ratio of boys to girls initial in a college is 5 : 6. If 40 boys leave the college and 50 girls join the college, the ratio will become 8 : 11. Find the number of girls (initial) in the college.
questions.solution_en:
Let the initial number of boys to girls be 5x and 6x respectively,

According to question,

(5x - 40)/(6x + 50) = 8/11

55x - 440 = 48x + 400

7x = 840

x = 120

required number of girls = 6 * 120 = 720

questions.q_en: If 4a + 4b + c = 0, then find the value of (9a2 + 9b2 + 9c2)/(5c2 - 18ab).
questions.solution_en:
Let c = 0

Then,

4a = -4b

a = -b

putting value of a and c in (9a2 + 9b2 + 9c2)/(5c2 - 18ab) we get,

[9(-b)2 + 9b2 + 9*(0)2]/[5(0)2 - 18(-b)b)

=> (9b2 + 9b2)/18b2 = 18b2/18b2 = 1

questions.q_en: The value of

Difference between the simple interest received on Rs.8500 at some rate of interest in 6 years and the simple interest received on same sum in 5 years when interest rate is decreased by 3 is Rs.2847.5. What is the actual rate of interest?
questions.solution_en:
We know, SI = sum * rate * time/100

Let actual rate of interest = R%

Then, SI on Rs.8500 at R% rate in 6 years = 8500 * R * 6/100 = 510R

SI on Rs.8500 at (R - 3)% rate in 5 years = 8500 * (R - 3) * 5/100 = 425R - 1275

Now, 2847.5 = 510R - (425R - 1275)

85R = 1572.5

R = 18.5

questions.q_en: Anil alone can complete a work for Rs.24000 in 30 days but with the help of Suresh, the work is completed in 20 days. The share to be paid to Suresh is:
questions.solution_en:
Let total work = LCM of 30 and 20 = 60 units

questions.q_en: If u2 + 7u - 2 = 0, then what is the value of (u2 + 14/u)?
questions.solution_en:
Given, u2 + 7u - 2 = 0 ---(1)

Multiplying above equation by (7/u), we get

=> 7u + 49 - 14/u = 0 ---(2)

Equating equation (1), and (2), we get

u2 + 7u - 2 = 7u + 49 - 14/u

=> u2 + 14/u = 51

questions.q_en: A and B run a 12 km race on a circular track of length 1200 m. They complete one round in 300 seconds and 400 seconds, respectively. After how much time from start will the faster person meet the slower person for the last time?
questions.solution_en:
They will first time after the start of the race in (LCM of 300 and 400) seconds which is equal to 1200 seconds.

And they will keep meeting at an interval of 1200 seconds.

Time taken by faster person to complete the race = (12 * 1000)/1200 * 300 = 3000 seconds

They will meet for the 2nd time and last time after 2400 seconds from start. Because after 3000 seconds, A will finish the race.

questions.q_en: Rupesh purchased raw materials for a certain price to manufacture a product. However, due to labor shortage, 27.5% of the raw materials could not be utilized and was wasted. 60% of the cost of raw materials used was added as the manufacturing cost. If Rupesh could sell his product at a price to earn an overall profit of 40% after offering a discount of 20%, how many times (round off 3 decimal places) the total cost of the raw materials purchased was the marked price of the product?
questions.solution_en:
Let Rupesh purchase 100 kg of raw material at Rs. 1 per kg.

Total C.P = 100 * 1 = Rs. 100

C.P of used raw material = 100 * 72.5/100 = Rs. 72.5

Manufacturing cost = 100 + (72.5 * 60/100) = Rs. 143.5

S.P = 143.5 * 140/100 = Rs. 200.9

M.P = 200.9 * 100/80 = Rs. 251.125

Hence, the required value = 251.125/100 = 2.511

questions.q_en: Pipe P and Q can fill a tank in 3 minutes and 12 minutes respectively and pipe R can empty it in 15 minutes. Find the time taken to fill the tank when all pipes are opened together.
questions.solution_en:
Capacity of tank = LCM of 3, 12 and 15 = 60 unit

Efficiency of pipe P = 60/3 = 20 units/minute

Efficiency of pipe Q = 60/12 = 5 units/minute

Efficiency of pipe R = 60/15 = 4 units/minute

Required time = 60/(20 + 5 - 4) = 60/21 or 20/7 = 2(6/7) minutes

Efficiency of pipe Q = 60/12 = 5 units/minute

Efficiency of pipe R = 60/15 = 4 units/minute

Required time = 60/(20 + 5 - 4) = 60/21 or 20/7 = 2(6/7) minutes

questions.q_en: The radii of two circles are r and R and the distance between their centres is C. Find the number of common tangents between these two circles, if C = r + R.
questions.solution_en: Distance between centres = sum of radii. So, we can say that circles are touching each other externally and, in this case, number of common tangents will be 3.
